thesis: Context is working material rather than permanent learning; prediction encourages useful structure without settling what understanding means.
role: Connect context engineering, compression, additional computation and open scientific questions.

ideas.statement: The context window contains instructions, documents, tools and outputs; truncation and compaction lose information, while application memory writes stored notes back into a new context.
Prediction and compression reward reusable regularities; in-context examples can steer behavior without updating weights.
Intermediate written steps and multiple attempts buy additional test-time computation, while multimodal inputs extend the same machinery beyond text.

evidenceAndExamples.statement: A long migration conversation can lose the initial operational constraints.

objectionsAndQualifications.statement: Sudden emergence, internal world models and understanding remain contested; honest behavior tests should lead judgment.

audit.notes: Entire assigned segment reviewed; scope and qualifications preserved. Duplicate contents and publication metadata are not ranked as ideas.
